name: fortune_teller
title: Fortune teller (cootie catcher)
description: Blintz, turn over, blintz again, then crease in half both ways. Stops at the flat final state: the real last step (push the four corners together and slide fingers into the square pockets to make it 3D) can't be shown by a flat simulator.

steps.description: Fold the bottom-left corner to the center.
Fold the bottom-right corner to the center.
Fold the top-right corner to the center.
Fold the top-left corner to the center.
Fold the bottom corner to the center.
Fold the right corner to the center.
Fold the top corner to the center.
Fold the left corner to the center.
Fold in half, right to left...
Turn over: four squares (the finger pockets). Push the corners together to open it in 3D.
